{ "handle": "wcct-adwords-events", "src": "", "ver": "{version}", "deps": [], "in_footer": true, "printed": true, "extra": { "after": [ false, "window.wcctPurchaseSent = window.wcctPurchaseSent || function (url, platform, orderId, key) {\n var sent = window.wcctPurchaseSent, all = sent.all = sent.all || {}, id = platform + \":\" + orderId;\n if (all[id]) return all[id];\n var done = false;\n var confirm = all[id] = function () {\n if (done) return;\n done = true;\n var body = new FormData();\n body.append(\"action\", \"wcct_purchase_sent\");\n body.append(\"platform\", platform);\n body.append(\"order_id\", orderId);\n body.append(\"key\", key);\n if (navigator.sendBeacon && navigator.sendBeacon(url, body)) return;\n var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();\n xhr.open(\"POST\", url);\n xhr.send(body);\n };\n confirm.when = function (check, category) {\n var consent = window.wcctConsent, tries = Math.ceil(30000 / 250);\n var allowed = function () { return !category || !consent || !consent.allows || consent.allows(category); };\n (function poll() {\n if (done) return;\n var ready = false;\n try { ready = allowed() && !!check(); } catch (e) {}\n if (ready) return confirm();\n if (!allowed() && consent.when) return consent.when(category, function () { tries = Math.ceil(30000 / 250); poll(); });\n if (--tries > 0) setTimeout(poll, 250);\n })();\n };\n return confirm;\n};\ngtag('event', 'conversion', {\n \"send_to\": \"AW-123456789/CtPurchaseLabel\",\n \"transaction_id\": 3001,\n \"value\": \"78.00\",\n \"currency\": \"USD\",\n \"event_callback\": window.wcctPurchaseSent(\"{home}/wp-admin/admin-ajax.php\", \"adwords\", 3001, \"wc_order_ctguest0001\"),\n \"event_timeout\": 60000\n});\n" ] } }
